description_sq: Shitet godine 3 kateshe prane Bllokut dhe Fakultetit Juridik. Godina eshte e perbere nga rreth 620 m katror ndertim e ndare ne 3 kate. title_en: 3-storey building for sale near the Block
description_en: 3-storey building for sale near the Block and the Faculty of Law. The building consists of about 620 square meters of construction divided into 3 floors. This area also includes 20 square meters of veranda. The building is very suitable for investors who want to rent apartments for daily or monthly rent. it is currently divided into 7 1+1 apartments. The area is one of the most frequented in Tirana. It can also be returned to the HOTEL. For more details, contact me.
